newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 4.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- New Frontier Party offers support for Okinawa land lease bill.
-- Mitsui and Co to start recruiting new graduates in June.
-- Support rate for Tokyo Governor Aoshima has fallen, survey says.
-- Law to be revised to suspend payment of retirement allowance to public servants suspected of taking bribes.
-- Japanese Red Army guerrillas detained in Lebanon used computers to prepare for armed struggle.
